correctness.rationale: Recomputed each two-update affine endpoint from T_i(x)=(1−ηλ_i)x∓ηc, namely (1,2):ηc(ηλ2), (2,1):−ηc(ηλ1), (1,1):−ηc(2−ηλ1), (2,2):ηc(2−ηλ2). RR averages mixed pair squares, IID averages all four pair squares; subtraction is η²c²[η(λ1+λ2)−2]. Objective gap is positive factor (λ1+λ2)/4 of x². Setting λi=L witnesses sharp eta=1/L despite each map contracting for eta<2/L. With equal λ the common deterministic r²x0 cancels and both noises mean-zero; difference of variances is 2η²c²(ηL−1) for arbitrary x0. Rational witness λ=3/2,η=c=1 gives RR 9/4,IID 5/4. Algebra covers all parameters; inspected finite-rational verifier source 1000+500 tests as corroboration.
